1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game
2: // Canvas must have id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
8: 
9:   // Ship
10:   const ship = {x: W/2, y: H/2, r: 10, vx: 0, vy: 0, speed: 0.2, fuel: 100};
11:   const keys = {};
12: 
13:   // Entities
14:   const asteroids = [];
15:   const fuels = [];
16:   let score = 0;
17:   let lastTime = 0;
18:   let gameOver = false;
19: 
20:   // Helpers
21:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
22:   const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
23: 
24:   // Input
25:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
26:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
27: 
28:   function spawnAsteroid() {
29:     const side = Math.floor(rand(0, 4));
30:     const obj = {r: rand(8, 20)};
31:     switch (side) {
32:       case 0: obj.x = 0; obj.y = rand(0, H); break; // left
33:       case 1: obj.x = W; obj.y = rand(0, H); break; // right
34:       case 2: obj.x = rand(0, W); obj.y = 0; break; // top
35:       case 3: obj.x = rand(0, W); obj.y = H; break; // bottom
36:     }
37:     const angle = Math.atan2(ship.y - obj.y, ship.x - obj.x);
38:     const speed = rand(0.5, 1.5);
39:     obj.vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
40:     obj.vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
41:     asteroids.push(obj);
42:   }
43: 
44:   function spawnFuel() {
45:     const obj = {
46:       x: rand(20, W-20),
47:       y: rand(20, H-20),
48:       r: 6,
49:     };
50:     fuels.push(obj);
51:   }
52: 
53:   function update(dt) {
54:     if (gameOver) return;
55:     // Ship controls
56:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) { ship.vy -= ship.speed; ship.fuel -= 0.02; }
57:     if (keys['ArrowDown']) { ship.vy += ship.speed; ship.fuel -= 0.02; }
58:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) { ship.vx -= ship.speed; ship.fuel -= 0.02; }
59:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) { ship.vx += ship.speed; ship.fuel -= 0.02; }
60:     // Apply friction
61:     ship.vx *= 0.99; ship.vy *= 0.99;
62:     ship.x += ship.vx * dt; ship.y += ship.vy * dt;
63:     // Keep inside bounds
64:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x = 0; if (ship.x > W) ship.x = W;
65:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y = 0; if (ship.y > H) ship.y = H;
66:     // Update asteroids
67:     for (let i = asteroids.length-1; i >=0; i--) {
68:       const a = asteroids[i];
69:       a.x += a.vx * dt; a.y += a.vy * dt;
70:       // collision with ship
71:       if (dist(a, ship) < a.r + ship.r) { gameOver = true; }
72:       // remove off‑screen
73:       if (a.x < -50 || a.x > W+50 || a.y < -50 || a.y > H+50) asteroids.splice(i,1);
74:     }
75:     // Fuel pickups
76:     for (let i = fuels.length-1; i >=0; i--) {
77:       const f = fuels[i];
78:       if (dist(f, ship) < f.r + ship.r) {
79:         ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + 30);
80:         fuels.splice(i,1);
81:       }
82:     }
83:     // Spawn logic
84:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
85:     if (Math.random() < 0.005) spawnFuel();
86:     // Score & end conditions
87:     score += dt/1000;
88:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
89:   }
90: 
91:   function draw() {
92:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
93:     // ship
94:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
95:     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ship.x, ship.y, ship.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
96:     // asteroids
97:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a33';
98:     asteroids.forEach(a => { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); });
99:     // fuel
100:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
101:     fuels.forEach(f => { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); });
102:     // HUD
103:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
104:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
105:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, 10, 20);
106:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(ship.fuel)}`, 10, 40);
107:     if (gameOver) {
108:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
109:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
110:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
111:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
112:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
113:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W/2, H/2);
114:     }
115:   }
116: 
117:   function loop(timestamp) {
118:     const dt = timestamp - (lastTime || timestamp);
119:     lastTime = timestamp;
120:     update(dt);
121:     draw();
122:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
123:   }
124:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
125: })();

(End of file - total 125 lines)
</content>
